node.label: Diem: decomposition algorithm in Poly(e^(n^2) log q)
node.statement: (a) n multihomogeneous polynomials of multidegree (d,...,d) on (P^1)^n have at most n! d^n isolated points counted with multiplicity, with equality iff the scheme is zero-dimensional. (b) A randomized algorithm (Rojas' toric resultants plus univariate factoring) outputs a list of size Poly(n! d^n) containing all F_q-rational isolated points in expected time Poly(n! d^n log q). Applied to the Weil descent S^(1..n) of S_{phi,n+1}(.., phi(P)) (multidegree 2^(n-1)), it lists all phi-isolated decompositions of P in expected time Poly(e^(n^2) log q).
node.scope: Finds only isolated decompositions; positive-dimensional components are skipped, not solved. This is why Diem needs no zero-dimensionality hypothesis: he only needs enough points with isolated decompositions.
node.formula: T_decomp = Poly(e^(n^2) log q); #isolated <= n! d^n
